summary: API key services parse strict runtime schemas and preserve omitted versus null configuration values.
Lifecycle reads and authorization use the transaction client; update and rotation require ACTIVE, and rotation compares the previously read hash before recording history.
Creation locks the organization row before enforcing the 25-active-key limit, generating material and creating key/audit records.
Added authorized success, stale-write, tenant/ownership, response secrecy, lock-contract and rollback-fixture regressions.
Added a reproducible dependency lock, typecheck script and nine source-based learning guides with exact verification evidence.
limits: Concurrency and rollback tests use fixtures and production-query spies, not a live PostgreSQL race.
The organization limit relies on cooperating create paths using the same row lock.
Existing local demonstration authentication is retained; no real external key was created or rotated.

checks.command: Recorded complete suite and build/type checks
